items.title: Lawson Named Conference USA Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State football sophomore defensive back Tay'vion Lawson was lauded for his performance in the Owls' 35-24 victory over FIU, being named Conference USA Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Monday.

items.title: Owls Soar to Fourth-Straight Win, Taming FIU, 35-24
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Running back Boogie Woods III and quarterback Landon Varnes combined to be responsible for four total touchdowns as Kennesaw State football kept FIU winless on the road, winning 35-24 at Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium.

items.title: The Night Before: Game Eleven vs. FIU
items.summary: Kennesaw State looks to win its fourth-straight Conference USA contest when it battles FIU on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 3 p.m. on ESPN+. Get ready for kickoff with a week's worth of content leading up to gameday.

items.title: Kennesaw State launches Georgia's first integrated Para sports program
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga.  – Kennesaw State University is launching Georgia's first integrated Para sports programs in athletics, creating new opportunities for elite Para student-athletes while advancing the University's commitment to excellence in athletics, education, and student success.

items.title: Kennesaw State Athletics Provides Design Update on Wellstar Champions Complex
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics announced Wednesday that the schematic design phase has been completed for the Wellstar Champions Complex, the 55,000-square-foot future daily home for Kennesaw State football.
